Write-Ahead Logging

SQLite implements atomic commit and rollback with either a rollback journal or a write-ahead log.

In WAL mode, changes are appended to a separate WAL file instead of overwriting the database file.

Readers do not block writers and a writer does not block readers, because readers keep using the original pages.

A checkpoint moves the transactions in the WAL file back into the original database file.

By default SQLite runs a checkpoint automatically when the WAL file reaches 1000 pages.
